notes.title: Update 10/24/20
notes.content:
Hello everyone, today we bring you a massive amount of bug fixes. I thank you from the bottom of my hart for all the love and support. May your frame rates be high and temperatures low.

Fixed bug were you cant interact with objects while carrying anything. Now you can open/ close doors and interact with the environment while holding physics objects.
Fixed level transition to were it doesn't just jump you to the next level. Now there is white noise post processioning going on before the next level loads.
New levels are now playable and old levels are updated with bug fixes and new encounter. Note that if you saved your game in an area that has been updated glitches will happen. I.e you old save file will react to the new save file and you will get old data mixed with new and the game will freak out. To fix this just delete your old save files and start fresh.  
Fixed the running bug were it sounds like your footsteps play sound faster then it feels like your running.
- A lot more bug fixes here and there too many to list.

notes.title: Flashlight, Lighter and Candle "Update"
notes.content:

- Other much smaller fixes here and there.
